lines = ax1.get_lines()
for line in lines:
    lbl = line.get_label()
    if not lbl.startswith('_'):
        x = line.get_xdata()
        y = line.get_ydata()
        idx = np.argsort(x)
        w200 = np.interp(200, x[idx], y[idx])
        w450 = np.interp(450, x[idx], y[idx])
        dm = w200 - w450
        line.set_label(f'{lbl} (Δm: {dm:.2f} wt%)')
